other_conditions: All Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in Himachal Pradesh must participate in the scheme
No exclusion for ULBs that have previously won the prize in earlier years
False claims may result in deduction of grant and disciplinary action
Claims must be submitted online on the prescribed application form by 30th September each year
Top‑scoring ULBs are selected based on Swachh Survekshan scores and five state parameters
Field verification of top‑scoring ULBs is carried out by a Third Party Agency
benefits_summary: Cash prizes up to ₹1.25 crore for Municipal Corporations, ₹1 crore for Municipal Councils and ₹75 lakh for Nagar Panchayats are awarded to the best‑performing Urban Local Bodies each year.
